# Module Index — updated 2026-08-25

| Path | Purpose | Public Interface | Critical | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| packages/server-go (root) | HTTP/WS entrypoint wiring: routes, autonomous repo scaffolding, Discord/GitHub bootstrap | main(), run(), /ws, /health, /quota, /quota/rate, /webhook/github | yes | main.go is a large init/wiring god-file; shallow route handlers inline business logic |
| packages/server-go/task_api.go (task_api.go) | In-memory task registry and REST surface for starting/cancelling/listing autonomous build tasks | engineTask, taskRegistry, startTask, /task, /task/cancel, /levers | yes | Task state lives only in-memory (no persistence layer) — leaky coupling to db/ai packages |
| packages/server-go/ai | Orchestrator brain: intake→plan→execute→review→validate pipeline, providers, teams, quota-aware routing, memory/critic loop | NewHandle, OrchestratorHandle.{Stop,Pause,Resume,Redirect}, RunAutonomousProject, OrchestratorConfig, roles/team_dispatcher, provider.go | yes | Largest module by far (~70 files); orchestrator.go/orchestrator_*.go split is wide but still tightly coupled — candidate for sub-package boundaries (intake, gates, dispatch) |
| packages/server-go/db | SQLite persistence: sessions, messages, learning events, memory ledger/residuals, usage dashboard, Discord message log | Open/New (db.go), Session, Message, LearningEvent, MemoryLedgerEvent, MemoryResidualNode/Edge, ProjectProfile, DiscordMessage | yes | Persistence layer; db.go is large and mixes many unrelated record types in one file |
| packages/server-go/quota | Multi-account Claude subscription quota tracking, efficiency ledger, model-config recommendation | Registry, Account, Identity, Ledger, NewLedger, Ledger.{Record,Stat,Recommend,Report}, Candidates, Plan.Apply | yes | Recent commit history shows active correctness work on quota-reading attribution (single-run responsibility) — watch for regressions here |
| packages/server-go/github | GitHub REST/OAuth client, repo event monitor/dedup, Projects V2 engagement, device-code identity | Client, NewClient(WithToken), Issue/PR/Comment types, EventsWatcher, RepoMonitor, ProfilePoller, webhook.go | yes | github.go and service files carry both API client and business logic (identity, engagement) — could split client vs. policy |
| packages/server-go/discord | Discord bot: control commands, issue bridge to GitHub, session-bound project bindings | NewService, Service, Config, ProjectBinding, ValidationResult | yes | service.go is 2000+ lines — single file owns config, bridge, validation, commands; deepen/split candidate |
| packages/server-go/mesh | LAN/local model mesh: inference request routing, exec, health across peer nodes | NewServer, NewClient, InferenceRequest/Response, Config, Peer, ExecRequest/Response | no | — |
| packages/server-go/remote | Remote pairing/auth server for desktop↔server connections (TLS, keychain-backed tokens) | NewServer, NewAuthManager, NewPairingManager, NewKeychainStore, /pair, /refresh | yes | Handles auth tokens/keychain — security-sensitive; keep in sync with vpn/ trust model |
| packages/server-go/vpn | Peer-to-peer VPN tunnel: identity, trust store, pairing/device revoke | LoadOrCreateIdentity, NewTrustStore, TrustStore.{AddDevice,RemoveDevice,IsTrusted}, NewTunnel, Tunnel.RegisterRoutes | yes | Overlaps conceptually with remote/ auth — two separate trust mechanisms, worth documenting the boundary |

plan.title: **Add gate-ai-coupling verification**
plan.body: Create gate-ai-coupling.dx with `::code run` block checking that ai/ module's export surface uses only the documented types (OrchestratorHandle, roles, provider). Gate reads all files in ai/ subdirectory, counts type definitions, and asserts no unexpected exports leak into task_api or db packages. Establishes coupling guardrail.
plan.acceptance: `grep -c "func (.*OrchestratorHandle)" packages/server-go/ai/*.go` returns count; gate passes only if count matches expected minimum.

plan.title: **Add gate-db-isolation verification**
plan.body: Create gate-db-isolation.dx asserting db.go's scope: reads Session, Message, LearningEvent, MemoryLedgerEvent, ProjectProfile, DiscordMessage—no more, no fewer. Gate counts struct definitions in db.go and fails if new record types are added without updating the gate's expected list.
plan.acceptance: `dx check ./gate-db-isolation.dx` passes; deliberately add a fake struct to db.go, re-run gate, confirm it fails with clear message.

plan.title: **Add gate-quota-ledger-attribution**
plan.body: Create gate-quota-ledger.dx verifying the recent commit's fix: Ledger.Record() now single-runs the attribution logic (each task run charged to one account). Gate reads quota/ledger.go, searches for Record() method, asserts no double-attribution patterns via code-pattern matching.
plan.acceptance: Run the gate; grep code intentionally for a pattern that would signal double-attribution (e.g., looping over accounts in Record); gate fails. Remove the pattern, gate passes.

plan.title: **Add gate-ws-leakiness detection**
plan.body: Create gate-ws-leakiness.dx detecting the known-leak: ws/handler.go mixes protocol parsing with feature logic (should be separate). Gate reads handler.go, counts lines, asserts file size stays ≤2500 (forcing refactor before it worsens). This is a "known-defect gate"—will fail until handler.go is split.
plan.acceptance: `wc -l packages/server-go/ws/handler.go` shows current line count; gate reads that count, asserts ≤2500, fails with directive to split parser from dispatch before adding more.

plan.title: **Add gate-discord-service-cohesion**
plan.body: Create gate-discord-cohesion.dx asserting that discord/service.go's functions are organized in three logical blocks (config, bridge, validation, commands). Gate reads the file, verifies function names start with expected prefixes (Config*, Bridge*, Validate*, Command*) in rough regions, fails if a random function appears.
plan.acceptance: `grep "^func (s \*Service)" packages/server-go/discord/service.go | head -20` shows method names; gate reads this, asserts prefixes match pattern, passes.

plan.title: **Add gate-quality-report-monolith alert**
plan.body: Create gate-quality-monolith.dx documenting the known-defect: quality/report.go is 2000+ lines covering parsing, indexing, and a dozen rule checks (prime refactoring target). Gate reads the file, asserts it stays ≥2000 lines and ≤3500 (bounded warning), fails if refactor happens without updating gate.
plan.acceptance: `wc -l packages/server-go/quality/report.go`; gate passes if line count is in expected range, fails otherwise with refactor-required message.

plan.title: **Add gate-mesh-independence confirmation**
plan.body: Create gate-mesh-isolation.dx asserting that mesh/ (marked "no" for Critical in Module Index) has zero imports from ai/, db, or quota packages. Gate reads mesh/*.go files, scans import blocks, fails if any of those three packages appear.
plan.acceptance: Run gate; grep imports in mesh/*.go; gate passes. Deliberately add an import from quota; gate fails. Remove the import; gate passes again.

plan.title: **Add gate-fs-and-git-read-only status**
plan.body: Create gate-fs-git-readonly.dx verifying that fs/ and git/ packages (both marked "no" for Critical) export only read-only operations (no WriteFile in fs/, no Commit in git/). Gate reads both packages, searches exported function signatures, asserts none modify state.
plan.acceptance: `grep "^func Write\|^func Commit" packages/server-go/fs/*.go packages/server-go/git/*.go`; gate passes if output is empty, fails if functions found.

plan.title: **Add gate-shared-types-drift detection**
plan.body: Create gate-shared-types-drift.dx detecting the hand-duplication risk: TS types in packages/shared/src must match Go structs in db.go (Session, Message, ToolCall, etc.). Gate reads both files, counts matching type names, fails if any Go struct lacks a TS counterpart.
plan.acceptance: List TS types: `grep "^export.*interface\|^export type" packages/shared/src/index.ts | wc -l`; list Go structs: `grep "^type.*struct" packages/server-go/db.go | wc -l`; gate compares, allows ±2 difference (for Go-only), fails on larger divergence.

plan.title: **Add gate-editor-store-scale check**
plan.body: Create gate-editor-store-scale.dx documenting that packages/client/src/store/index.ts is a single large Zustand store (acceptable for now). Gate reads the store file, counts custom hooks (useStore.*, useState patterns), asserts ≤30 custom selectors (forcing split before complexity explodes).
plan.acceptance: `grep "export const use\|export const.*=" packages/client/src/store/index.ts | wc -l` returns hook count; gate passes if ≤30, fails with directive to split store by feature domain.

plan.title: **Verify all gates and update index.dx worklist**
plan.body: Run all gates via a consolidated `::code run` block that loads each gate document and checks that verdicts are cached. Resolve any gate failures by fixing the code or adjusting gate parameters. Once all pass, use `dx check ./index.dx now-worklist --item 12` to mark item 12 complete. Commit all gate documents and the index update.
plan.acceptance: `dx check ./index.dx now-worklist --item 12` returns success; `git log --oneline -3` shows new commits for gate implementations; `git status` shows clean tree.
